title: Well-Quasi-Ordering Eulerian Digraphs: Bounded Carving Width
summary: We prove that every class of Eulerian directed graphs of bounded carving width (equivalently of bounded degree and treewidth) is well-quasi-ordered by strong immersion. In fact, we prove a stronger result, namely that every class of Eulerian directed graphs of bounded carving width, where every vertex is additionally labeled from a well-quasi-order, fixes a linear order on its incident edges, and may impose further restrictions on how the immersion is allowed to route paths through it, is well-quasi-ordered by an adequate notion of strong immersion.
